nav.starbridge.flight.board: Stand on a deck of your ship, then set the course at the helm.
nav.starbridge.flight.dismount: Leave the seat and stand on the deck, then try the maneuver again.
nav.starbridge.flight.cabin_space: The orbital cabin needs more room. Wait for the surrounding chunks and try again.
nav.starbridge.flight.physics: Open the installation check and install Valkyrien Skies before entering the atmosphere.
nav.starbridge.flight.hull_size: The hull extends beyond the landing survey. A smaller hull is required at this berth.
nav.starbridge.flight.border: Part of the ship would cross the world border. Pick a point farther inside the map.
nav.starbridge.flight.survey_changed: The landing surface changed. Check the site again or select another spot.
nav.starbridge.flight.ceiling: The hull needs more vertical clearance. Select another berth.
nav.starbridge.flight.occupied: The berth is occupied. Select a clear berth on the landing map.
nav.starbridge.flight.interrupted: Flight operations are on hold. Stay aboard and check the helm before continuing.
orbit.starbridge.crew.bridge_hint: Use %s on the helm in flight to read the crew instruments.
orbit.starbridge.crew.title: Crew flight display
nav.starbridge.lift.permission: Remote helm authorization changed. Confirm the pairing at the bridge and set the course again.
orbit.starbridge.radar.help: The top of the scope points forward. Select a ship to track its distance and closing speed. Range: 5,000 navigation units.
orbit.starbridge.title: Orbital helm
orbit.starbridge.leave_tip: Walk around your ship. Use the bridge again to resume the view.
orbit.starbridge.retry_survey_tip: Retry this berth or choose another on the map.
orbit.starbridge.landing_survey_timeout: Terrain loading timed out. Retry the survey or choose another berth.
orbit.starbridge.home_tip: Pick a berth at port altitude. The center square selects the recorded port.
orbit.starbridge.site_tip: Click the area map to survey a berth. The outline shows your hull.
orbit.starbridge.occupied_tip: Select another berth on the map, or choose Go around.
orbit.starbridge.home_occupied_tip: This berth is occupied. Select a nearby spot on the chart or go around.
orbit.starbridge.assist: Cruise lines up with the body and slows to entry speed.
orbit.starbridge.approach_required: Close the distance and reduce speed on the landing display.
orbit.starbridge.no_fuel: Add fuel at the bridge. Landing and return energy is reserved.
orbit.starbridge.leave_cabin: The helm is paused. Return aboard and reopen the bridge.
orbit.starbridge.board: Assemble your rocket, then board its fixed cabin to use the orbital helm.
orbit.starbridge.already: This ship already has a course. Reopen the bridge to resume it.
orbit.starbridge.launch_fuel: Add fuel for powered flight, landing and the return trip.
orbit.starbridge.no_pilot: Only the captain of this orbital flight can take the helm.
orbit.starbridge.human: The captain has claimed manual control.
orbit.starbridge.site: Choose a coordinate inside the landing grid.
orbit.starbridge.bounds: The hull survey exceeds its supported bounds.
orbit.starbridge.going_around: Climbing away from the landing corridor
orbit.starbridge.go_around_tip: Cancel the approach and fly clear of the planet.
orbit.starbridge.holding: Clear of the approach. Holding position.
orbit.starbridge.landing_hull_changed: The hull changed during the survey. Scan the selected berth again.
orbit.starbridge.landing_route_changed: That route is unavailable. Reopen the star chart and check the destination.
orbit.starbridge.landing_low_energy: Landing and return reserve is low. Refill the bridge before confirming.
orbit.starbridge.condition_fault: Drive fault: thrust halved. A crew member can repair it in the cabin by using two iron ingots on the ship core.
orbit.starbridge.condition_emergency: Emergency return: hull at %s%%. The ship is heading back to its port of departure.
orbit.starbridge.debris_hit: Debris is striking the hull. Slow below 80 blocks/s or steer around the field.
orbit.starbridge.fault: Drive fault! Thrust halved until a crew member repairs it at the ship core with two iron ingots.
orbit.starbridge.rescued: Survivors and cargo recovered from the distress beacon. Check the cabin chests.
orbit.starbridge.emergency: Hull integrity lost. Emergency return to the port of departure; the fare is charged on landing.
orbit.starbridge.measuring: Measuring the hull. Wait a moment, then launch again.
orbit.starbridge.capacity: This route needs more drive energy than the core can hold. Add Advanced Rocketry fuel tanks to the ship.
